package: Sandero / Sandero Stepway MY26 2026-11-02 cennik reconciliation
scope: Official Polish price list only; no brochure or configurator assimilation.
technical_and_equipment_tables: All nine pages visually reviewed. Page 4 and page 5 were reconciled against master data; 69 technical/dimension observations were added. Existing equipment states and already-covered technical facts were not duplicated. Eco-G injection and LPG tank-capacity semantics, accessory material and commercial campaigns remain explicitly deferred.
source_integrity: Official PDF URL recorded and all nine rendered pages reviewed. Raw PDF bytes could not be downloaded/archived in this session; SHA-256 remains unavailable and is not fabricated. Cross-cennik comparison: the official Jogger 2026-11-02 cennik page 6 explicitly distinguishes Eco-G petrol direct injection/LPG port injection and LPG total/fillable capacity 50/40 l.
next_package: Jogger MY26 2026-10-01 price matrix correction: correct 7-seat Eco-G120 grade alignment and complete source-to-configuration relationships.

technical_data.reconciliation: The page-4 technical table was compared with all 19 exact configurations. Existing engine displacement, cylinder/valve counts, engine power/torque, torque/power RPM, top speed, emission standard, gearbox, and already-matching WLTP values were reused without duplicate rows. Seventeen exact fuel-context WLTP observations were added/reconciled. The official page-4 VDA cargo value of 328 dm3 is recorded for the nine Eco-G 120 configurations, preserving earlier 372 dm3 observations. Hybrid 155 multipoint injection, 0-100 acceleration and electric-motor torque (205 Nm at 7,000 rpm) were added where previously missing. Eco-G injection and LPG tank-capacity details remain deferred because the Sandero cennik does not distinguish fuel-specific injection or total versus fillable LPG capacity; the official Jogger cennik explicitly distinguishes petrol direct/LPG port injection and LPG total/fillable 50/40 l.
technical_data.conflict_resolution: For TCe100/TCe110, the 2026-11-02 official cennik values 5.4/122 and 5.7/128 were added with explicit petrol context. This preserves older observations and resolves conflicts with some 2026-08-09 saved configurator PDFs whose values were unqualified by fuel type. For Eco-G, only exact fuel-specific cells that differed from the current master were added.

dimension_data.model_scope: The rendered page-5 diagram is explicitly titled Sandero and is not a Stepway dimension page. It gives 10 model dimensions; two exact Sandero Hybrid 155 configurations lacked these observations and received 10 each. Existing non-hybrid Sandero dimensions were reused except for seven later official 1,853 mm body-width observations.
dimension_data.width_conflict: The page-5 diagram explicitly shows 1,853 mm body width and 2,012 mm including mirrors. The repository also contains 1,753 mm overall-width observations from saved configurator PDFs dated 2026-08-09 for Sandero configurations. The 2026-11-02 official cennik confirms 1,853 mm; prior observations were retained and the later official observation was added rather than destructively overwritten.

page_inventory.classification: 19 configurations reviewed; 15 catalogue prices +500 PLN; four Hybrid 155 prices unchanged. Up to 3,000 PLN catalogue discount and up to 7% MFS benefit recorded as separate commercial messages, not catalogue prices.

page_inventory.section: Model description and promotional feature copy
page_inventory.classification: Descriptive marketing copy; no new configuration fact or separately priced item imported.

page_inventory.classification: Equipment applicability reviewed; option rows reconciled in the 209 dated mappings. The combined paint label and printed 2,600/2,800 PLN values retain their exact scope; spare wheel explicitly excludes LPG.

Rear camera, standalone Media Nav Live, glass sunroof and COMFORT/THERMO/WINTER/MEDIA NAV LIVE/EASY packages reconciled; existing equipment cells reused where already represented. Legend and package-only P states preserved.

42 technical observations added or reconciled. WLTP values, VDA cargo volume and Hybrid 155 injection/acceleration/electric-motor torque are source-backed. Eco-G injection and LPG tank-capacity semantics remain explicitly deferred against the cross-cennik evidence boundary.

27 dated dimension observations added or reconciled for Sandero only; Stepway applicability was not inferred. 1,853 mm body width conflicts with some older saved-configurator 1,753 mm observations; the later official cennik value is retained as a new observation. Additional interior dimension callouts were reviewed but deferred where no canonical attribute preserves their exact meaning.
Accessory descriptions and QR references reviewed. This page contains no accessory prices; it points to a separate accessory price list. No prices or configuration compatibility inferred.

deferred_items.subject: Eco-G 120 injection type
deferred_items.reason: The Sandero cennik page 4 states direct injection without separating fuels. The official Jogger cennik page 6 for Eco-G 120 explicitly states petrol direct injection and LPG port injection. Assigning one unqualified state to both fuels would be misleading.
deferred_items.next_action: Retain fuel-specific injection states only when the Sandero source or a clearly applicable shared-powertrain source is formally reconciled.

deferred_items.subject: Eco-G 120 LPG tank capacity
deferred_items.reason: The Sandero table gives LPG 40 l and petrol 50 l without stating whether the LPG figure is total or fillable capacity. The official Jogger cennik explicitly distinguishes LPG total/fillable capacity as 50/40 l. The current generic fuel_tank_capacity attribute cannot safely represent both meanings.
deferred_items.next_action: Defer until the exact Sandero applicability and a distinct total-versus-fillable capacity attribute are established.

deferred_items.subject: Interior dimension callouts
deferred_items.reason: The Sandero dimension diagram includes interior/cabin measurements that do not have an unambiguous canonical attribute mapping from the rendered labels. They were not projected into generic interior_width/interior_height fields.
deferred_items.next_action: Review the rendered diagram against an explicit attribute contract before any import.
